name: Agent: a task
objective: A task carried out by a model that uses tools until it calls finish: it reads, proposes changes for review, checks them, and says what it did and what is left. Nothing it proposes is applied until a person accepts it.

main.about: the model that works the task and decides which tools to use

files.label: Files (a library space)
files.hint: A folder it reads directly and changes only by proposals, which wait in that space's review (Tessa > Review, or wherever the review panel is).

space.label: Its own space
space.hint: A folder name it keeps notes in between runs, written directly. Empty: none.

check_tool.label: Goal check: tool
check_tool.hint: Run when it calls finish (check_files with Files: new problems in what it proposed). Problems send it back to work.

check_pipeline.label: Goal check: pipeline
check_pipeline.hint: Given task and summary; it gives ok and feedback.

num_ctx.label: Context window (tokens) to keep the conversation inside

written.label: Tell it the written call form too
written.hint: For a model or program without tool calling of its own. Calls written in the text are read either way.
